In this video, you’ll get a clear, easy-to-understand explanation of what artificial intelligence (AI) is, all through the relatable story of Liam, a 19-year-old college freshman. You’ll discover how AI is already part of your everyday life—whether it’s advanced tools like ChatGPT helping with research or simpler AI like Siri and Google Assistant assisting with daily tasks. We’ll dive into real-world examples of AI in action, from social media apps and AI-powered photo editors to more advanced technologies like self-driving cars, including Liam’s father’s Tesla. You’ll also get a breakdown of how AI is transforming major industries like healthcare (analyzing medical images), banking (detecting fraud), and entertainment (recommending your favorite Netflix shows). In just 8 minutes, you’ll learn: What AI is and how it works. How AI learns and improves over time using deep learning. How AI is simplifying complex tasks in everyday life. The impact of AI on industries like healthcare, finance, retail, and more. How AI is not about robots taking over but about making life more efficient and convenient. By the end of this video, you’ll understand how AI quietly shapes our world and helps make your daily life easier—often without you even realizing it! Whether you're curious about AI or just want to know how it affects you, this quick and engaging video is the perfect introduction. Don't miss out on unlocking the power of AI in your own life!
